up: Retrieve metabolism records where the enzyme name contains 'CYP3A4' or 'CYP3A5'. For each record, include the following details: substrate compound name (pref_name from molecule_dictionary), metabolite compound name (pref_name from molecule_dictionary for metabolite_record_id), metabolic conversion description (met_conversion), pathway key (pathway_key), and organism (taxon from organism_dictionary via substrate record). Order by met_id and limit results to the first 200 records.
sql:
WITH sub_met AS (SELECT m.met_id, m.met_conversion, m.pathway_key, m.organism, m.met_comment, m.substrate_record_id, m.metabolite_record_id, sub.pref_name AS sub_mol_name, met.pref_name AS met_mol_name
FROM metabolism m
JOIN molecule_dictionary sub ON m.substrate_record_id = sub.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary met ON m.metabolite_record_id = met.molregno
WHERE m.enzyme_name LIKE '%CYP3A4%' OR m.enzyme_name LIKE '%CYP3A5%'
)
SELECT
  sub_mol_name AS substrate_compound_name,
  met_mol_name AS metabolite_compound_name,
  met_conversion AS metabolic_conversion,
  pathway_key,
  organism
FROM sub_met
ORDER BY met_id
LIMIT 200;
